title: Disputes Desk Basis: Leak Adjustment Credits on Disputed Water Usage Lines
content:
# Leak Adjustment Credits — Utility Services Program

**Subject.** A leak adjustment credits part of the charge of the water usage line named by the most recent suspected-leak dispute in submitted status on a Utility Services Program account (the disputed line). The credit is posted against the disputed line.

**Condition of the grant.** A leak adjustment is not granted until the resident has paid the undisputed balance of the account. Until that payment has been made, the leak adjustment is not granted.

**Effect of the credit.** Once posted, the credit appears among the account's lines, linked to the line it credits; the suspected-leak dispute recorded against that line shows as credited; and the account's outstanding utility balance falls by the credit.

## Posting the credit: `credit_leak_adjustment_a9c6c674`

The resident services agent decides a suspected-leak dispute with a credit through `credit_leak_adjustment_a9c6c674`: the agent unlocks the tool and calls it. One call records one leak adjustment credit dated today against the named bill line, for the service and month of that line, lowers the account's outstanding utility balance by the credit, and marks the suspected-leak dispute recorded against that line as credited. The tool computes nothing and checks no condition.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `utility_account_id` | the reference number of the resident's utility services account, as returned by the utility account lookup | identifier |
| `source_bill_id` | the reference number of the disputed water usage line being credited, as returned by the bill line lookup or named on the dispute record | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the leak adjustment credited, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; zero or positive |

### Receipt

When the credit has been posted the tool returns:

- `status` — the string "credited";
- `bill_id` — the reference number of the new credit;
- `source_bill_id` — the line credited;
- `credit_amount` — the credit, 2 decimal places;
- `disputes_marked` — how many disputes against that line were marked credited, an integer;
- `balance_due` — the account's outstanding utility balance after the credit, 2 decimal places.
